recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crispy chickpeas packed with garlic and Parmesan flavor for a healthy snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and drain 1 can (400g) of chickpeas thoroughly.
Toss chickpeas with 2 tbsp of olive oil, 1 tsp of garlic powder, 1/2 tsp of salt, and 1/4 tsp of pepper in a bowl.
Spread chickpeas evenly on a baking sheet and roast at 200°C for 25 minutes, tossing halfway.

recipes.title: Cheesy Spinach and Artichoke Dip
recipes.description: Creamy dip with spinach and artichokes, perfect for crunchy chips or bread.
instructions: Thaw 300g of frozen spinach and drain well, squeezing out excess moisture.
Preheat oven to 180°C and chop 2 cloves of garlic finely.
Mix in a bowl 200g cream cheese, 100g sour cream, 300g spinach, 1 can (400g) chopped artichokes, 100g mozzarella, 50g parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Transfer the dip into a baking dish and sprinkle with extra mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake dip at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until bubbling and golden on top.

recipes.title: Mini Beef Empanadas
recipes.description: Savory beef-filled pastries, flaky and perfect for dipping or snacking.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and finely chop 1 small onion and 1 clove of garlic.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat, then add onion and garlic, sautéing until softened.
Add 250g ground beef, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, salt, and pepper; cook until browned and cooked through.
Roll out 300g of dough and cut into circles; fill each with beef mixture and fold.
Beat 1 egg and brush it on each filled empanada before placing on a baking sheet.
Bake empanadas at 200°C for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and flaky.

recipes.title: Carrot and Zucchini Fritters
recipes.description: Crispy veggie fritters packed with healthy carrots and zucchini, perfect for dipping.
instructions: Grate 1 medium (200g) zucchini and 1 medium (100g) carrot, then squeeze out excess moisture.
Combine the grated zucchini and carrot with 1/2 cup (60g) flour, 2 large eggs, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat and add spoonfuls of the mixture to form fritters.
Flip the fritters after 5 minutes when they're golden brown and cook for another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Thai Peanut Rice Cakes
recipes.description: Crispy rice cakes topped with a spicy peanut sauce and fresh veggies.
instructions: Mix 3 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and 1 tsp sriracha in a bowl.
Spread the peanut sauce evenly over 4 rice cakes.
Top each rice cake with sliced cucumber, julienned carrot, and cilantro.
Drizzle 1 tbsp lime juice over the topped rice cakes before serving.

recipes.title: Spanish Patatas Bravas
recipes.description: Crispy potatoes accompanied by a spicy tomato and garlic sauce, a fiesta of flavors!
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Toss 500g diced potatoes with 3 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp salt.
Spread the potatoes on the baking tray and bake for 25 minutes until crispy.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté 3 minced garlic cloves.
Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, and 1 tsp smoked paprika to the pan.
Pour in 1 tbsp red wine vinegar and simmer for 2 minutes while stirring well.
Serve the crispy potatoes drizzled with the spicy tomato sauce.

recipes.title: Mango and Sticky Rice Spring Rolls
recipes.description: Refreshing spring rolls filled with sweet mango and creamy coconut sticky rice.
instructions: Mix 1 cup cooked sticky rice with 1/4 cup coconut milk and 2 tbsp sugar.
Soak 8 spring roll wrappers in warm water until pliable, about 30 seconds.
Place 2 tbsp coconut sticky rice and mango strips in the center of a wrapper.
Fold the sides over and roll tightly to enclose the filling.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds before serving.

recipes.title: Savory Cheddar and Chive Scones
recipes.description: Fluffy scones packed with sharp cheddar and fresh chives.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Combine 2 cups (240g) all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, and 1 tsp salt in a bowl.
Cut in 1/4 cup (60g) butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in 1 cup (120g) grated cheddar cheese and 1/4 cup (10g) chopped chives until evenly mixed.
Add 1/2 cup (120ml) milk and 1 beaten egg, mixing until a dough forms.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead gently before rolling to 1-inch thickness.
Cut into rounds and place them on the prepared tray.
Bake for 15-20 minutes at 200°C until golden brown and risen.

recipes.title: Spicy Chickpea Patties
recipes.description: Crunchy chickpea patties seasoned with a kick of spices for flavor.
instructions: Mash 1 can (400g) drained chickpeas in a large bowl until mostly smooth.
Incorporate 1 medium finely chopped onion and 2 minced garlic cloves into the chickpeas.
Mix in 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp paprika, and season with salt and pepper.
Add 1 beaten egg and 1/2 cup (50g) bread crumbs for binding, then mix well.
Shape the mixture into patties, about 10 in total, and set aside for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat; place the patties in the hot oil.
Fry the patties for 5 minutes until golden brown, flipping halfway through.

recipes.title: Mini Quiches with Spinach and Feta
recipes.description: Delicate and fluffy mini quiches filled with spinach and creamy feta cheese.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C and grease a mini quiche pan lightly with oil.
Sauté 2 cups (60g) fresh spinach in a pan with a dab of oil until wilted.
In a bowl, whisk together 4 large eggs, 1/2 cup (120ml) heavy cream, and 1/2 cup (120ml) milk.
Mix in crumbled 1/2 cup (75g) feta cheese and season with salt, pepper, and 1/4 tsp nutmeg.
Add the wilted spinach into the egg mixture, stirring to combine evenly.
Roll out the pie crusts and fit them into the mini quiche pan.
Fill each crust with the egg and spinach mixture until nearly full.
Bake the mini quiches at 190°C for 25-30 minutes until set and lightly browned.

recipes.title: Spicy Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crunchy, flavored roasted chickpeas perfect for a light snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and prepare a baking sheet.
Drain and rinse the 1 can (400g) of canned chickpeas, then pat them dry with paper towels.
Toss the dried chickpeas with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the chickpeas evenly on the baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes at 200°C until crispy.
